title: City — GIS & location
body: The largest scale: digital twins on open 3DBAG and point-cloud data, and location-based AR anchored to the real world with Visual Positioning Systems and centimetre-accurate RTK GPS.

title: Room — games, apps & websites
body: Human scale: VR training, games, apps and websites — interactive experiences people step into, from a training simulator to hyper-casual mobile hits.

title: Chip — tools, CV & data
body: The smallest scale: the tools, computer vision, AI and data plumbing underneath — cross-platform AR frameworks, synthetic data, LLM-driven characters and the backends that hold it all together.
